install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-global"; CHROME_BIN="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"; if [ -n "$CHROME_BIN" ]; then export PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH="$CHROME_BIN"; LINE="export PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=\"$CHROME_BIN\""; grep -qxF "$LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi; PATH_LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"'; grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/mmdc" ] || [ ! -x "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/markdownlint-cli2" ]; then npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund --prefix "$HOME/.npm-global" @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli markdownlint-cli2; fi
